description: This file defines a SwiftUI wrapper component for a QR code scanner using UIKit's UIViewControllerRepresentable, with callback handlers for successful scans and errors. It integrates with custom scanner view controller for scanning QR codes, handles scan results, and manages error reporting accordingly.

classes.name: QRScannerView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that wraps a UIKit view controller for scanning QR codes, providing callback closures for gateway links, errors, and dismiss actions.

classes.name: Coordinator
classes.description: A delegate class implementing the DataScannerViewControllerDelegate protocol to handle scan results and errors, and to communicate with the QRScannerView's callbacks.

methods.name: makeUIViewController
methods.description: Creates and configures the DataScannerViewController, setting delegate, enabling scanning, and handling unsupported or unavailable device states.

methods.name: updateUIViewController
methods.description: Empty implementation required by protocol, does not update the view controller.

methods.name: dismantleUIViewController
methods.description: Stops scanning and calls onDismiss callback when the view controller is dismantled.

methods.name: makeCoordinator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Coordinator instance to handle delegate callbacks.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Reports an error message via the onError callback, ensuring only one error is reported.
